description: Enhanced boundary coverage for the security-routing filter. Confirms that non-security markers are denied in both modes: an information-classification marker (CONFIDENTIAL) and a non-security event marker (EVENT SUCCESS) both yield DENY in default mode, and even with the accept-all switch enabled a non-security CONFIDENTIAL marker is still denied (accept-all only elevates genuine security-event markers). Also re-confirms the default mode neutral decision via an explicit accept_all=false flag.
